## 📝 Pull Request Description

Provide a concise summary of the changes made in this PR and why they are necessary.

Fixes #(issue number if applicable)

---

## 🧪 Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] 🛡️ Security / Safety enhancement
- [ ] 🎨 UI / Material You styling update
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🛠️ Refactoring / CI maintenance

---

## 🛡️ Safety & Quality Verification Checklist

Please verify the following before submitting:

- [ ] **Build Check**: The code builds cleanly using `.\gradlew.bat :app:assembleUniversalDebug`.
- [ ] **Privacy Check**: No tracking code, telemetry, or invasive third-party SDKs have been added.
- [ ] **Security Check**: No hardcoded API keys, tokens, or unencrypted storage sensitive data.
- [ ] **UI Check**: Tested across dark/light themes and different Android screen sizes.
- [ ] **Code Style**: Follows Kotlin and Jetpack Compose standard conventions.
- [ ] **Documentation**: Updated README / inline comments if behavior changed.
